step6_report.mechanism_text: Ixazomib (Proteasome inhibitor; target(s) PSMB5) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include ADGRA1-AS1, LINC01109, OR2C3; most repressed include OAS2, CMPK2, OR51C1P.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Idarubicin (hydrochloride) (phenotype similarity 0.324), which is annotated as DNA synthesis/repair inhibitor. Nearest-reference distance 0.676 places Ixazomib in a sparse region beyond the reference's reliable range (out-of-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step6_report.headline: Trametinib — MEK inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Trametinib (MEK inhibitor; target(s) MAP2K2, MAP2K1) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include USP17L14P, RNU6-217P, DUX4L8; most repressed include EGR1, SPRY4, GOLGA8DP-1.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Binimetinib (phenotype similarity 0.296), which shares its mechanism annotation (MEK inhibitor) with shared targets MAP2K1, MAP2K2. Nearest-reference distance 0.704 places Trametinib in a sparse region beyond the reference's reliable range (out-of-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step2_fingerprint.basis: mean log2FC across cancer cell lines (NOT tissues); displayed genes = top named symbols (unnamed ENSG/pseudogenes excluded)

step5_reliability.metric: 1 − phenotype cosine similarity to nearest reference drug
step5_reliability.basis: 375-drug Tahoe reference; tertile bands p33=0.561 p66=0.666

step6_report.headline: Dabrafenib — RAF inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Dabrafenib (RAF inhibitor; target(s) RAF1, BRAF) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include RPL10L, PRORY, POLR2J3-1; most repressed include A2ML1-AS2, NKX2-2-AS1, OFD1P7Y.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Paclitaxel (phenotype similarity 0.499), which is annotated as Microtubule inhibitor. Nearest-reference distance 0.501 places Dabrafenib in a well-populated region of the reference (in-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step6_report.headline: Lapatinib — EGFR/ERBB inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Lapatinib (EGFR/ERBB inhibitor; target(s) EGFR, ERBB2) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include IGHV3-38, RBMY2GP, SSTR3; most repressed include TBC1D3, CLEC14A, LINC00895.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Dabrafenib (phenotype similarity 0.333), which is annotated as RAF inhibitor. Nearest-reference distance 0.667 places Lapatinib in a sparse region beyond the reference's reliable range (out-of-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step6_report.headline: Paclitaxel — Microtubule inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Paclitaxel (Microtubule inhibitor; target(s) unannotated) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include CRYAA, H2BC8, LINC01665; most repressed include OR51A4, RNU6-44P, LINC01300.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is BAY1125976 (phenotype similarity 0.5), which is annotated as PI3K/AKT inhibitor. Nearest-reference distance 0.5 places Paclitaxel in a well-populated region of the reference (in-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step2_fingerprint.basis: mean log2FC across cancer cell lines (NOT tissues); displayed genes = top named symbols (unnamed ENSG/pseudogenes excluded)

step3_embedding.projection: PCA(2) of 375-drug HVG-2000 z-scored phenotype space

step5_reliability.metric: 1 − phenotype cosine similarity to nearest reference drug
step5_reliability.basis: 375-drug Tahoe reference; tertile bands p33=0.561 p66=0.666

step6_report.headline: Palbociclib — CDK inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Palbociclib (CDK inhibitor; target(s) CDK6, CDK4) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include OR13C9, LINC02799, TAF11L11; most repressed include RNU4-2, LINC01839, SPRR2B.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is TAK-733 (phenotype similarity 0.243), which is annotated as MEK inhibitor. Nearest-reference distance 0.757 places Palbociclib in a sparse region beyond the reference's reliable range (out-of-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step2_fingerprint.basis: mean log2FC across cancer cell lines (NOT tissues); displayed genes = top named symbols (unnamed ENSG/pseudogenes excluded)

step3_embedding.projection: PCA(2) of 375-drug HVG-2000 z-scored phenotype space

step5_reliability.metric: 1 − phenotype cosine similarity to nearest reference drug
step5_reliability.basis: 375-drug Tahoe reference; tertile bands p33=0.561 p66=0.666

step6_report.headline: Rapamycin — MTOR inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Rapamycin (MTOR inhibitor; target(s) FKBP1A, MTOR) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include Metazoa_SRP-100, OR7E15P, FAM74A3; most repressed include Y_RNA-340, RNU4-2, LCN9.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Idarubicin (hydrochloride) (phenotype similarity 0.533), which is annotated as DNA synthesis/repair inhibitor. Nearest-reference distance 0.467 places Rapamycin in a well-populated region of the reference (in-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step6_report.headline: Bicalutamide — Androgen receptor antagonist
step6_report.mechanism_text: Bicalutamide (Androgen receptor antagonist; target(s) AR) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include RNU1-42P, RNU6-648P, LINC01332; most repressed include GNPATP, TRBV13, RNU1-35P.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Indacaterol (maleate) (phenotype similarity 0.329), which is annotated as Adrenoceptor agonist. Nearest-reference distance 0.671 places Bicalutamide in a sparse region beyond the reference's reliable range (out-of-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step2_fingerprint.basis: mean log2FC across cancer cell lines (NOT tissues); displayed genes = top named symbols (unnamed ENSG/pseudogenes excluded)

step3_embedding.projection: PCA(2) of 375-drug HVG-2000 z-scored phenotype space

step5_reliability.metric: 1 − phenotype cosine similarity to nearest reference drug
step5_reliability.basis: 375-drug Tahoe reference; tertile bands p33=0.561 p66=0.666

step6_report.headline: Bexarotene — Retinoic receptor agonist
step6_report.mechanism_text: Bexarotene (Retinoic receptor agonist; target(s) RXRA, RXRG, RXRB) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include OR4X2, ARHGEF7-AS1, OR10R1P; most repressed include OR51C1P, PALLD-AS1, SSX2.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Lactate (calcium) (phenotype similarity 0.325), which is annotated as unclear. Nearest-reference distance 0.675 places Bexarotene in a sparse region beyond the reference's reliable range (out-of-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step2_fingerprint.basis: mean log2FC across cancer cell lines (NOT tissues); displayed genes = top named symbols (unnamed ENSG/pseudogenes excluded)

step5_reliability.metric: 1 − phenotype cosine similarity to nearest reference drug
step5_reliability.basis: 375-drug Tahoe reference; tertile bands p33=0.561 p66=0.666

step6_report.headline: Panobinostat — HDAC inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Panobinostat (HDAC inhibitor; target(s) HDAC2, HDAC8, HDAC3, HDAC11, HDAC10, HDAC1, HDAC6) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include MIR7-3HG, LINC01511, PLIN5; most repressed include OR51C1P, OAS2, RNU6-949P.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Belinostat (phenotype similarity 0.439), which shares its mechanism annotation (HDAC inhibitor) with shared target HDAC6. Nearest-reference distance 0.561 places Panobinostat in a well-populated region of the reference (in-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step6_report.headline: Decitabine — DNA methyltransferase inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Decitabine (DNA methyltransferase inhibitor; target(s) DNMT3B, DNMT3A, DNMT1) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include IRS4-AS1, DEFA5, Metazoa_SRP-87; most repressed include PALLD-AS1, RNU6-933P, RN7SL205P.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Berbamine (dihydrochloride) (phenotype similarity 0.308), which is annotated as unclear. Nearest-reference distance 0.692 places Decitabine in a sparse region beyond the reference's reliable range (out-of-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step2_fingerprint.basis: mean log2FC across cancer cell lines (NOT tissues); displayed genes = top named symbols (unnamed ENSG/pseudogenes excluded)

step3_embedding.projection: PCA(2) of 375-drug HVG-2000 z-scored phenotype space

step5_reliability.metric: 1 − phenotype cosine similarity to nearest reference drug
step5_reliability.basis: 375-drug Tahoe reference; tertile bands p33=0.561 p66=0.666

step6_report.headline: Capivasertib — PI3K/AKT inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Capivasertib (PI3K/AKT inhibitor; target(s) AKT1, ROCK2, RPS6KB1, PRKACA, AKT2, AKT3, ROCK1) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include OR2B11, FAM197Y1, Metazoa_SRP-142; most repressed include CLEC12A-AS1, SEMG1, ARHGEF7-AS2.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Idarubicin (hydrochloride) (phenotype similarity 0.301), which is annotated as DNA synthesis/repair inhibitor. Nearest-reference distance 0.699 places Capivasertib in a sparse region beyond the reference's reliable range (out-of-domain).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.

step2_fingerprint.basis: mean log2FC across cancer cell lines (NOT tissues); displayed genes = top named symbols (unnamed ENSG/pseudogenes excluded)

step5_reliability.metric: 1 − phenotype cosine similarity to nearest reference drug
step5_reliability.basis: 375-drug Tahoe reference; tertile bands p33=0.561 p66=0.666

step6_report.headline: Crizotinib — Multi-TK inhibitor
step6_report.mechanism_text: Crizotinib (Multi-TK inhibitor; target(s) ROS1, ALK, MET) produces a broad transcriptional response averaged across 50 cancer cell lines (Tahoe-100M, 5.0 µM vs within-cell-line DMSO). Its most induced genes include OR4A16, FAM197Y9-1, RRN3P3-1; most repressed include RNU1-35P, SSX2, DAZ1.
step6_report.confidence_text: Nearest reference neighbor is Citalopram (hydrobromide) (phenotype similarity 0.34), which is annotated as unclear. Nearest-reference distance 0.66 places Crizotinib in the edge of the reference's populated region (near-edge).
step6_report.caveat: Proof-of-concept on a public cell-line reference (Tahoe-100M, 50 cancer cell lines), standing in for the zebrafish atlas.
